title: Galecraft: Recreated
description: A complete remake of Galecraft, once a mod and now a modpack, tons of different content for everyone.
body:
Galecraft, exactly as it was originally envisioned.

Around 200 mods, adding many different things to the Minecraft experience.
Main mods are: Create (and some addons), TaCZ (Timeless and Classics Zero), Valkyrien Skies, Origins, and more!

Important things of note:
- Requires more than 4gb of ram (at least for singleplayer)
- There is proximity chat, make a walkie talkie to chat long distances

Heres a short video showing some of the things in the modpack
